title: Rebalance running work with bounded KV migration
after: Estimate remaining work and transfer cost
Import KV and resume on the shared engine
focus: Accepted policy: at most 5 requests per probe, 2 attempts, 2-second admission budget.
evidence: 14.72% lower training-loop time vs. fixed allocation; isolated migration benefit pending ablation.
zh: KV 迁移已实现并验证请求接续。收紧策略共享整体耗时比固定双卡低 14.72%；迁移本身的独立贡献仍待消融实验确认。探索每次最多 5 个请求、最多 2 次，累计耗时达到 2 秒后不再发起新探索。

title: Reserve training memory first; admit inference into the remainder
focus: Separate weight copies; memory admission does not guarantee compute priority.
evidence: Functional overlap verified. E001 admitted all six steps; work availability still limited card 1.
zh: 先为训练状态、工作区和安全余量保留显存，再将剩余预算用于推理 KV。训练与推理保留独立权重，允许重叠不代表一定有请求可运行，也不保证计算不争用。

title: Each inference replica resumes after its own version fence
focus: Dedicated readiness no longer depends on shared readiness.
evidence: Historical combined run: dedicated readiness preceded shared by 3.96 s on average.
zh: 固定推理卡完成自己的 HCCL 加载、确认版本后就恢复；共享卡独立等待快照加载完成再加入。图中两条发布路径逻辑独立，并非依次等待。

title: Drain or migrate: minimize the next training critical path
before: Wait too long or migrate too soon
focus: J(action) = max(T_answers_ready, T_training_card_ready). Unknown costs are not zero.
evidence: Retain regressions and forecast errors. Fewer migrations alone did not imply a faster loop.
zh: 从最多三个已完成批次建立滑动窗口，分别预测整题回答收齐时间和训练卡就绪时间，取两者最大值作为下一次训练的启动时间，再比较继续排空与迁移。

title: Rebalance queued requests with an acknowledged ownership handoff
status: IMPLEMENTED / NO MOVES IN INSPECTED RUNS
focus: Only WAITING, never-scheduled requests qualify. No KV is transferred.
evidence: E001: all five decisions found no queued work; no isolated speedup can be attributed.
zh: 优先处理公共等待请求，再检查从未执行的原生队列请求。原引擎确认取消之后才交给目标，确保同一时刻只有一个所有者；已运行请求不在此策略范围。

title: Reserve virtual space; map physical KV only as needed
focus: Logical block IDs stay stable; reclaim only synchronized, confirmed-idle whole pages.
evidence: Validation: initial KV 112 MiB; peaks 336/784 MiB. Historical pools were about 21.2 GiB.
zh: 保留逻辑地址和块编号，只给实际使用的 KV 映射物理页，并优先填充部分占用的 slab。空闲页面解除映射，不把虚拟地址空间等同于实际显存占用。

title: Borrow training capacity while rollout is waiting
focus: npu_share changes device roles and admission, not the training group's membership.
evidence: Single-card switching preserves optimizer ownership; it is a capacity saving, not guaranteed speedup.
zh: 等待训练批次时让训练卡参与推理，批次就绪时通过安全交接重新用于训练。训练进程仍持有优化器，训练分布式组没有被动态缩小或扩展。

title: Publish a flat immutable weight snapshot instead of an HF package
focus: Snapshot lifetime must outlive actor offload. Normal checkpoints retain HF format.
evidence: Historical 16 publications: 124.69 → 83.16 s; not a controlled loop-only attribution.
zh: 内部权重更新只导出扁平化的推理精度权重，通过原子版本清单发布，省去重复打包配置和 tokenizer。快照必须独立拥有存储，不能被训练端后续改写。

title: Remove snapshot queue blocking from the HCCL producer
focus: Independent readers remove the queue dependency; memory bandwidth contention can remain.
evidence: Two dedicated publications: 8.10 → 3.81 s. Full-loop reduction was only 2.7%.
zh: 不是简单增加线程，而是拆开读取路径：HCCL 和快照线程独立读取已稳定的权重，不再由 HCCL 生产者向有界队列投递。下一次改写权重之前仍必须等待所有读取结束。

title: Let the main loop acquire work while the shared tail finishes
focus: Overlap acquisition with tail work; never race the next optimizer update.
evidence: Next acquisition 39.616 s; shared ready 43.960 s. Historical loop still regressed 4.76%.
zh: 固定推理卡就绪后主循环立即获取下一批，快照、共享卡恢复及部分收尾在后台串行执行。到下一次修改训练权重、评估或退出之前仍需要汇合等待。

title: Eliminate final publication only when nobody needs it
focus: An epoch boundary alone is not finality. Required evaluation still gets fresh weights.
evidence: Later runs recorded one skipped terminal publication; no isolated percentage is established.
zh: 只有确定训练真正结束且没有评估需要新权重时，才跳过无用的推理权重发布和恢复。最终模型保存、已有后台任务汇合及清理仍然执行。

title: Continue a logical answer on another card by replaying its prefix
focus: Tokens and ownership move; KV is rebuilt, not copied between devices.
evidence: Migration can cross weight versions with provenance; not one uninterrupted fixed-policy sample.
zh: 暂停后保留已生成 token、对数概率及版本信息，拿到卡2的租约后重放前缀、重新生成 KV 再继续。这里没有直接搬运 KV，也不能把跨版本续写等同于单一固定策略采样。

title: Keep question groups together without confusing concurrency limits
before: Wait for slowest answer of Q1
focus: Global question concurrency ≠ per-engine sequence capacity. Affinity ≠ sibling prediction.
evidence: At c32: request routing 70.81 s; affinity 72.33 s. Affinity was 2.1% slower in this run.
zh: 同题回答初始放到同一个引擎，按未完成题组负载分配，但引擎容量仍按请求限制。图解是可选机制，不代表它已获得正收益；同题亲和性与已删除的同题长度预测是两回事。

title: Prewarm optimizer state; make memory queries observational
focus: Do not change weights, gradients or learning rate during prewarm.
evidence: Same-input replay: total PPO about 5.3% lower, mainly the first batch; later overhead remained.
zh: 显存预算允许时提前异步创建优化器池和状态，优化器步数仍为零，不更新参数。内存状态查询去掉清缓存副作用，训练使用前等待预热完成。

title: Park inactive training cache and restore it before it is needed
focus: Inactive cache bytes need no RAM backup. Train only when both batch and memory are ready.
evidence: 39 segments / about 10.33 GiB reclaimed. Unmap/remap about 0.053/0.279 s, not zero cost.
zh: 仅解除完全空闲训练缓存段的物理映射，保留地址；这些无效数据无需复制到 RAM。利用等待回答的时间提前恢复映射，批次与内存都准备好才训练。

title: Warm actual Ascend execution paths before announcing readiness
focus: Eager execution does not disable JIT. Startup cost is moved, not erased.
evidence: Cold 5.645 s window: compile + load accounted for 99.24%; post-warm longest window 0.049 s.
zh: 在服务宣布就绪前预热真实模型和 block-table 路径，而不是无关的空算子。编译和加载成本移入启动阶段；比较时必须同时报告启动和稳态时间。

title: Offload only enough complete allocations to cover the shortfall
focus: Allocation granularity may overshoot; this is not per-layer operator-time streaming.
evidence: Functional identity/pressure checks exist; no isolated repeated partial-versus-whole speedup.
zh: 先计算真实显存缺口，优先回收空闲工作区和 KV，再按完整分配块将必要的有效状态备份到 RAM。不是全部搬走，也不是运行到某层时才即时换层。

title: Retain old-version KV on the same card across training
after: Wait for complete batch; pause keep
Retain KV; partial backup if needed
Drain old answers → load new weights
focus: Never pair retained old KV with overwritten new weights. Waiting early can deadlock a batch.
evidence: 52 same-card/version continuations; RL run did not exercise RAM backup. Migration remains default.
zh: 在批次收齐后原卡暂停并保留旧版本 KV，显存不足才部分备份。训练后先恢复旧推理状态完成残留请求，再更新共享推理权重；避免新权重直接使用旧 KV。

title: Estimate surviving tails without amplifying sibling bias
status: TAIL MODEL RETAINED / SIBLING SCALE REMOVED
focus: Better prediction error does not automatically mean a faster schedule.
evidence: Q94 mean remaining: actual 39.83 tokens; tail-only 119.24; sibling-scaled 146.46.
zh: 未完成回答属于截尾观测，按已生成长度估计条件剩余长度，并考虑活跃并发降低时 TPOT 的变化。去掉会共同放大同题回答预测偏差的乘数，同时保留失败证据。

title: Test TP=2 on identical long tails before building migration
focus: TP=2 was 20.42% slower here, before deployment or KV redistribution costs.
evidence: Five repeats per condition. Specific small-model result; dynamic TP/KV migration not implemented.
zh: 使用相同长尾请求和固定剩余 token 数，在预热好的 TP1 与 TP2 实例分别重复测试。TP2 此处反而更慢，因此不应将双卡单实例迁移包装成已成功的优化。

title: Keep one sharing protocol; adapt backend memory and publication
focus: Preserve optimizer ownership and backend semantics; this is not a new RL algorithm.
evidence: c16 six-batch run: fixed 159.02 s; shared 147.96 s. Different output lengths limit attribution.
zh: 共享协议复用，但运行时、内存池覆盖、状态预算和权重发布需要针对 Megatron 适配。先单批验证再对照，不把某一次后端实验结果当成普遍加速比。

title: Per-rank memory decisions; all-rank readiness for TP execution
after: Rank B: partial KV backup / restore
Admit TP group only after every ACK
focus: 2 / 4 / 8 NPUs; one fixed training group. No elastic resizing of training ranks.
evidence: 8-card TP2 functional run and asymmetric native pressure test are separate evidence.
zh: 显存预算逐卡判断，宽裕的卡不搬，紧张的卡只处理自己的缺口；但 TP 实例必须等全部成员就绪才能执行。多卡不是多个独立训练任务，也不是弹性改变训练组成员。

title: Match conditions and trace causality before claiming a speedup
focus: Tracing can perturb performance. Fixed placement uses the same instrumented fork.
evidence: Keep token counts, reward counts and audit gaps. Rollout reward is not independent model evaluation.
zh: 冻结代码、数据和参数，固定与共享保持一致的并发、日志及沙箱限制，记录请求、版本和设备事件，再生成四类图和双语总结。观测本身可能影响性能，固定组也不是未经修改的上游代码。

title: Only the consumed batch must finish before its optimizer update
status: UPSTREAM ASYNC CONTEXT / NOT A NEW CONTRIBUTION
before: Wait for all answers in N
focus: In-flight future tasks can coexist with training; version logging is not permanent binding.
evidence: AReaL already provides async rollout and max_head_offpolicyness controls.
zh: 训练只要求被消费的当前批次收齐，其他在途任务可以继续推理，在离策略限制内使用旧权重。异步 rollout 属于 AReaL 上游能力，不应写成此次新增创新。
